reason: Independent top-level agents can explicitly opt into same-project discovery, send durable idempotent peer messages, consume them through provider or harness runtimes, and see sender-attributed system callouts in chat. Five focused Python tests cover eligibility, project isolation, idempotency, provider injection, and harness steering/inbox fallback. Forty-six selected Vitest cases include four settings serialization tests and the existing App render matrix with a peer-message assertion. Three catalogued Assistant-settings entries match six browser checks across desktop and mobile Chromium/WebKit.
exclusions: No full suite, native tests, unrelated provider tests, or unrelated browser journeys. The selected Playwright journey uses a mocked Core and validates the adjacent Assistant settings surface; there is not yet a catalogued real-Core two-agent browser journey. Production build is checked separately. LAN-origin and physical-device evidence are unavailable, so those completion gates will be reported as unverified rather than inferred from emulation.
